notes: Recipe validated 2026-08-24 on the four_bolt_adaptor print after four consecutive first-layer failures on the stock profile (wispy non-adhering extrusion). This spool is far less forgiving than Bambu PETG: it needs a 10min 90C bed soak, 90C held through a half-speed first layer, then a 5C/layer ramp down to 70, and flow 0.94. Same numbers previously worked for gridfinity prints on this spool (user's recollection, now confirmed).
